target_customer: Researchers, analysts and engineers at R&D and applied science organizations
problem: Research and experimentation require slow human loops of planning, running and analyzing; Antinuous wants agents to run thousands of experiments and simulations autonomously.
business_model: Platform subscription with compute and agent usage (inferred; pricing not public)
product_category: Autonomous research agents and simulation platform

founders.name: Ricardo Nunez
previous_startups: Salesgraph (YC page says Antinuous started as Salesgraph)
founders.background_notes: YC page names one founder; team size listed as 2 with the second founder unnamed. Page hints the team worked at Mintlify but gives no roles.

competitors.name: Edison Scientific
competitors.what: Commercial AI Scientist (Kosmos), spun out of FutureHouse

technical_complexity.rationale: Autonomous multi-step research with orchestration, simulation and sourcing of outputs is hard for two people, though built on frontier models.

defensibility.rationale: Agent orchestration layers are copyable and frontier labs and well-funded startups target the same space.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large funded rivals and model providers were already shipping AI scientist products by late 2025.

market_need_then: Strong investor and customer interest in AI for science in 2025 to 2026, evidenced by very large seed rounds for rivals. Antinuous claims users at large organizations on its site (unverified).

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and promotional, bold claims such as 100x more experiments

brand_strength.rationale: No external brand coverage found. Name appears to be a coinage and may be misspelled as 'Antinuous'.

pivots.from: Salesgraph, agents for enterprise sales teams
pivots.why: Not stated beyond the YC page note that the company started as Salesgraph

outcome_analysis: Antinuous is a Spring 2026 company with no outcome yet. It reportedly pivoted from a sales agent product (Salesgraph) into autonomous research, entering a field where Edison Scientific and Periodic Labs raised very large rounds. The small team and low defensibility are the main risks, while the market tailwind is strong.
notes: Search found no independent coverage. FundedIQ lists Salesgraph with $500K pre-seed June 2026, aggregator only, unverified and the link to Antinuous is not confirmed. Salesgraph has its own YC listing, so the relationship is unclear. Not recorded as a round.
